{{Top|leg}}
'''Quinto grain''' was a form of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] used to cultivate certain types of food. It was the basic crop of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]], and could be used in food like veggie patties.<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
